description: This file defines a Paypal class for handling PayPal adaptive payments within the Goteo project, including methods for retrieving payment details and express checkout details, utilizing external PayPal SDK services.

classes.name: Paypal
classes.description: A class to handle PayPal adaptive payments, including retrieving payment details and express checkout details, with error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Paypal object with an Invest instance and checks if the method is 'paypal'.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the list of errors encountered during operations.

methods.name: paymentDetails
methods.description: Retrieves payment details from PayPal, handling preapproval, transaction, and express checkout cases.

methods.name: paymentExpressCheckoutDetails
methods.description: Retrieves express checkout payment details from PayPal using a token.
